subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). D sits third to the left of E. G sits second to the left of B. Only E sits between F and G. A is not an immediate neighbour of D. Who sits fourth to the right of C?
solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

G sits second to the left of B. Only E sits between F and G.

D sits third to the left of E. A is not an immediate neighbour of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c4312d2a75f9cdcf071e0aad24a16eb44c1d5a060df017e7bf33199d14f7319.png] 

Thus, 'A' sits fourth to the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
